JSW Dulux: Guidance - - Concall Update

• Management expects EBITDA margins to be in the range of 13% to 15%, driven by crude prices.

• The company's strategic vision is to become a number two player overall, aiming for the number one position in Industrial Coatings within 1 to 1.5 years, with a broader 2030-2031 vision.

• For the Decorative business, the mission is to continuously gain market share and deliver absolute EBITDA.

• Investments in R&D and adding approximately 160 people in sales are considered a "correction" to build a strong foundation, not an annual addition, with expectations for EBITDA margins to return to the target band.

• Project Akshaya, an integration program with JSW Paints, is a three-year roadmap designed to unlock synergies, reduce duplication, and fund growth initiatives.

MORGAN STANLEY ON PAINT SECTOR

KEY TAKEAWAYS

Increased competitive intensity across players continues

Opus clearly highlighting the focus on Rs 10000 cr revenue target by FY28 and 50% + growth for FY27

Birla Opus posted revenue at Rs 1660 cr a 64% YoY, 17% QoQ revenue growth vs 16% QoQ standalone revenue growth for Asian Paints

Opus gained 30 bps market share sequentially and including putty, their market share is nearing early-teens

Dulux too re-emphasized the ambition of gaining the no.3 spot and no.1 spot in terms of market share in the decorative and industrial space respectively

DECCAN GOLD MINES | Q1 FY27 — Key Takeaways

Explorer → Producer: Jonagiri has started commercial production, while Kyrgyzstan has begun Dore production. Gold sales generated ₹87 Cr revenue and project PAT was ₹25 Cr.

Strong gold growth runway: Jonagiri targets 500–600 kg/year, rising to 750–800 kg in FY28, with expansion from 1,000 TPD → 2,500 TPD potentially taking production toward 2 tonnes/year.

Multiple gold assets: Finland’s Kalevala has 5–6+ tonnes potential, while Ganajur could add ~1 tonne/year if the court issue is resolved.

Critical minerals are the next big opportunity: Balukona (Nickel-Copper-PGE), Spain (Tungsten) and Mozambique (Lithium-Tantalum) are moving through exploration/resource-definition stages.

₹137 Cr fundraise: Intended mainly to accelerate exploration and critical-mineral development.

Big picture: Deccan is transitioning from a single-theme gold explorer into a multi-commodity mining company, but execution, approvals, exploration outcomes and future capex remain key risks.

Pilani Investments In Focus

Stake sale in UltraTech could translate into a significant dividend income for public shareholders as well

This could translate into a dividend per share of Rs 1,380 – 31.7% dividend yield

SWARAJ SUITING IN FOCUS

To start trading in mainboard from today (SME migration) for both NSE/BSE

Strong buying seen and numbers recorded in Q1

Stock up 31% in Last 3 Months

Aditya Birla Promoters could garner close to Rs 700 cr annually from Royalty charges

Grasim could see the biggest hit on standalone numbers

Strong Q1 From Mach Travel Solutions

22-year old tech enabled travel solutions company in corporate travel, MICE, B2B and B2C segment,

Analysts say mainboard in 12 months.

Interesting to track. 

Stock trading at P/E of 17x on lower side. 

Mkt Cap Rs 360cr

Target ₹3600

Recommendation Outperform

KEY TAKEAWAYS

In our recent meeting, management shared that -

like-for-like growth will face pressure until the share of smaller-town store additions stabilises;

slower like-for-like growth may not materially impact the margin profile as costs are lower in small towns;

reiterating its target of 200-250 annual store additions; and

multiple margin levers make it confident of managing near-term input cost pressures

ASTRAL Q1 CONCALL ; RETAINS DOUBLE-DIGIT PLUMBING VOLUME GROWTH, PAINTS GUIDANCE COULD BE EXCEEDED

• 🚰 Plumbing: Targets minimum double-digit volume growth in FY27 with EBITDA margin of 16–18%

• 🧴 India Adhesives: Targets 15–20% revenue growth with ~15% EBITDA margin

• 🎨 Paints: FY27 revenue growth guidance at 20–25%, with management confident of exceeding it after a strong Q1; expects low single-digit EBITDA margin

• 🚀 Management sees healthy growth across all verticals, supported by strong demand momentum since July

GUJARAT FLUOROCHEMICALS Q1 CONCALL ; TARGETS 17–20% FLUOROPOLYMER GROWTH, BATTERY MATERIALS SET TO SCALE

• 📈 Fluoropolymers: Targets 17–20% annual growth, driven by higher volumes and richer high-value product mix

• 🧪 Fluorochemicals: Expected to become a meaningful profitability contributor, supported by R-32 expansion and new R-134a capacity

• 🔋 Battery Materials: Commercial contribution expected to begin in FY27 following customer qualifications

• 🚀 Targets ₹100 Cr+ quarterly revenue run-rate from Battery Materials by Q4 FY27, with significant scale-up expected in FY28

• ⚡ Management sees strong multi-year demand from EV and battery energy-storage markets

• 🏭 Backward Integration: Additional AHF capacity being added in phases, with first phase targeted by Q3/FY27-end for captive consumption

HAL: ₹1 LAKH CR RFP FOR 60 TRANSPORT AIRCRAFT

Programme value: ~₹1 lakh Cr

Aircraft to replace ageing An-32 fleet and support some IL-76 roles

Indian companies including HAL, Tata and Mahindra invited to bid

Indian firms to lead the programme with global aircraft OEM partners

Major opportunity for domestic defence manufacturing.

GRASIM Q1 CONCALL ; BIRLA OPUS TARGETS 50%+ FY27 GROWTH, ₹10,000 CR REVENUE BY FY28

• 🎨 Birla Opus: Targets 50%+ YoY revenue growth in FY27, with market-share gains remaining the key priority

• 🎯 Paints business maintains long-term target of ₹10,000 Cr revenue by FY28

• 🧪 Chemicals: ECH plant commissioning targeted in Q2 FY27

• ⚗️ Chlorine integration expected to increase to 68% by FY27-end, supporting value addition and profitability

RETAIL F&O TRADERS LOSE ₹91,685 CR IN FY26 V ₹ 1.1 Lk In FY25 — GOVT DATA

• 📉 78.6 lakh individual/retail traders participated in F&O in FY26 V 98.1 Lkh In FY25

• 👤 Average loss per trader: ₹1.17 lakh V ₹ 1.13 Lkh 

• 📊 F&O turnover stood at a massive ₹202 lakh crore V ₹ 213 Lkh Cr 

• 🔻 Trader participation fell from 98.1 lakh in FY25 to 78.6 lakh in FY26

• 💰 FY25 losses were even higher at ₹1.12 lakh crore

• ⚠️ Across FY22–FY26, retail F&O traders recorded cumulative net losses of around ₹3.85 lakh crore

• 📝 Data is based on the top 15 brokers, covering approximately 90% of individual investors in the equity derivatives segment.

JYOTHY LABS Q1 CONCALL ; TARGETS DOUBLE-DIGIT FY27 GROWTH, MARGIN RECOVERY EXPECTED IN H2

• 📈 Targets double-digit FY27 revenue growth excluding Pril, driven by high single-digit volume growth and pricing

• ⚠️ Q2 margins to remain under pressure due to high-cost inventory

• 💰 Management expects H2 FY27 margins to be significantly better than H1, subject to commodity-price stability and demand

• 📢 A&P spend moderated to 6.5% of revenue vs 7.8% YoY in Q1; brand investments to increase in coming quarters

• 🌾 Rural demand remains resilient, while urban consumption continues to be a concern

• 🚀 Growth strategy focused on volumes, selective pricing, premiumisation and scaling new products

PYRAMID TECHNOPLAST Q1 CONCALL ; TARGETS ~15% FY27 REVENUE GROWTH & 11–12% EBITDA MARGIN

• 📈 Management targets ~15% revenue growth in FY27

• 💰 EBITDA margin targeted at 11–12%, with FY27 EBITDA guidance of ₹80–86 Cr

• 📊 Capacity utilisation expected to improve to 70–75% for FY27 vs 62% in Q1, as export disruptions ease and demand recovers

• 📉 Polymer prices expected to decline by around ₹20/kg, which could support margin expansion despite moderating value growth

• 🏗️ FY27 CapEx planned at ₹20–25 Cr, mainly for the new Kutch facility and funded through internal accruals

• 🚀 New product line is under testing; machinery installed and commercial launch expected after customer approvals over the next 1–2 months

TECHNO ELECTRIC Q1 CONCALL ; RETAINS ₹4,000+ CR FY27 REVENUE GUIDANCE, ORDER INFLOW TARGET LIKELY TO BE EXCEEDED

• 📈 FY27 revenue guidance maintained at ₹4,000+ Cr, with EBITDA margin expected at 13–14%

• 📚 FY27 order inflow target of ₹4,000 Cr likely to be exceeded; already won ₹2,200 Cr orders with another ₹2,100 Cr at L1 stage

• 🖥️ Data Center business currently expected to contribute around ₹40 Cr revenue in FY27, with more concrete guidance likely in H2

• 🚀 Data Center revenue expected to be H2-weighted as customer deals close and workloads get deployed

• 📊 Business remains seasonally back-ended — Q1 ~15%, H1 ~40% and H2 ~60% of annual revenue

SKIPPER Q1 CONCALL ; RETAINS 15% FY27 GROWTH GUIDANCE, TARGETS ₹7,000+ CR ORDER INFLOW

• 📈 Maintains 15% revenue growth guidance for FY27 despite Q1 growth of just 4.5%; execution expected to be H2-weighted

• 📚 Targets ₹7,000+ Cr order inflow in FY27, taking closing order book to ₹10,000+ Cr

• 🌍 Export order inflow expected at ~₹1,100 Cr, up ~50% YoY

• 💰 EBITDA margin on a structural improvement path towards the long-term 12% aspiration, aided by better order mix and exit from legacy low-margin contracts

• 🏭 Stronger capacity utilization, normalization of export logistics and execution of recently won orders expected to support H2 growth

• 💳 Following the ₹433.5 Cr fundraise, FY27 finance costs guided at 3.2–3.5% of revenue

**UTSSAV CZ GOLD JEWELS | CARE RATINGS UPGRADED**

 **Rating Highlights**
- Long-term rating upgraded to CARE BBB+.
- Earlier rating stood at CARE BBB.
- Outlook remains Stable after upgrade.
- Facility reduced from ₹2 Cr to ₹1.66 Cr.

 **Facility Updates**
- ₹247 Cr facilities rated CARE BBB+.
- Short-term rating reaffirmed at CARE A3+.
- Facility limit increased from ₹147 Cr to ₹247 Cr.
- Long-term rating upgrade signals stronger credit profile.

**CLSA ON AUTOS | COMMODITY INFLATION & DEMAND OUTLOOK**

 **Commodity Inflation**
- CVs face higher raw material inflation.
- Steel prices increased around 20%.
- Rubber prices saw steep increases.
- OEMs need 6–7% price hikes.
- Further hikes may not be required.
- Aluminium correction supports margin protection.
- Lower crude prices ease cost pressure.
- 4–5% price hike may be sufficient.

 **Demand Outlook**
- PV and 2W growth aided by GST cut.
- Low base also supports growth.
- EV adoption progressing without subsidies.
- Passenger EV launch pipeline remains key.

**CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL – MACQUARIE REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- U-P maintained
- Target Price: ₹940

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue grew 17% YoY
- Revenue beat expectations
- Abrasives grew 20% YoY
- Ceramics grew 16% YoY
- Electromineral grew 16% YoY

**Profitability**
- EBITDA grew 11% YoY
- PAT grew 23% YoY
- Both below estimates
- Gross margin fell 350bps

**Margin Pressure**
- Higher input costs impacted margins
- Pricing partly offset cost pressure
- Profitability remains under pressure

**Guidance**
- Revenue guidance raised
- PAT guidance lowered
- Higher costs weigh on outlook
- Overseas closure delays remain concern

**Investment View**
- Revenue growth remains strong
- Margin pressure limits earnings
- Overseas closures key monitorable

Venus Pipes & Tubes (+ve)

Good Q1-Management Commentary Steady

**VODAFONE IDEA – JPMORGAN REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- UNDERWEIGHT initiated
- Target Price: ₹9

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue beat estimates
- EBITDA beat estimates
- Revenue +3% QoQ
- EBITDA +3% QoQ
- Margin broadly flat at 43%

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- ARPU +2% QoQ
- ARPU: ₹177 vs ₹176 estimate
- Net adds: 0.3 Mn
- First positive net adds since merger

**Capex**
- Capex: ₹1,930 Cr
- Capex declined 16% QoQ
- Below JPM estimate of ₹2,300 Cr

**Key Concern**
- Bank funding remains unavailable
- Funding crucial for capex
- Funding needed to sustain market share

**Investment View**
- Q1 performance ahead of expectations
- Subscriber additions turning positive
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains key stock risk

**VODAFONE IDEA – CLSA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- HOLD maintained
- Target Price: ₹13

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Revenue: ₹11,680 Cr
- Revenue +3% QoQ / +6% YoY
- EBITDA: ₹5,030 Cr
- EBITDA +3% QoQ / +9% YoY
- EBITDA in line with estimates

**ARPU & Subscribers**
- Mobile ARPU +2% QoQ / +7% YoY
- Subscribers added: 0.3 Mn
- Total subscribers: 193 Mn
- First positive net additions post-merger

**Debt Position**
- Total debt: ₹1.53 lakh Cr
- Spectrum debt: ₹1.30 lakh Cr
- Debt remained stable QoQ

**Capex & Funding**
- Planned investment: ₹45,000 Cr
- Debt funding being pursued
- Funding remains key monitorable

**Investment View**
- Subscriber trend showing improvement
- ARPU growth remains supportive
- Funding remains critical for capex

**VODAFONE IDEA – NOMURA REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- NEUTRAL maintained
- Target Price: ₹12.6

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Results broadly in line
- No major surprises
- 3-year capex program begins

**Key Trigger**
- Debt-capital raise remains crucial
- Successful fundraise could support outlook

**Key Catalysts**
- Successful debt-capital raise
- Industry tariff hikes
- Faster subscriber additions
- Strategic equity investment

**Investment View**
- Funding remains key concern
- Tariff hikes could aid recovery
- Subscriber growth remains monitorable
- Equity capital could boost confidence

**GLAND PHARMA – GOLDMAN SACHS REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- SELL maintained
- Target Price: ₹2,125
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Sales grew 20% YoY
- EBITDA grew 33% YoY
- EBITDA margin: 27.2%
- Margin expanded 275bps YoY

**Margin Drivers**
- Favourable product mix
- Higher CDMO contribution
- Improved capacity utilisation
- Cost optimisation supported margins

**Business Growth**
- CDMO grew 20% YoY
- B2B grew 19% YoY
- US growth remained strong
- US revenue grew 32% YoY

**FY27 Outlook**
- Q1 growth: 15% constant-currency
- FY27 growth guidance: ≥15% CC
- RTU bag approval could add upside
- Approval expected in 3QFY27

**Valuation**
- Trades at 28x FY28E P/E
- FY26–28E EPS CAGR: 22%
- Valuation seen expensive

**Key Risks**
- Core business margin headwinds
- Cenexi turnaround may take longer
- Pre-acquisition margins may be delayed

**Investment View**
- Strong Q1 execution
- Growth outlook remains healthy
- Valuation limits upside
- Cenexi remains key monitorable

**GLAND PHARMA – JEFFERIES REPORT HIGHLIGHTS**

**Brokerage View**
- BUY upgraded
- Target Price: ₹3,350
- Target price raised

**Q1FY27 Performance**
- Strong beat vs estimates
- US market grew 32% YoY
- US growth drove performance

**FY27 Outlook**
- Growth potential raised to 15% CC
- Earlier guidance: 12–13%
- Growth outlook improving

**Growth Drivers**
- Major CDMO contract signed
- Large TAM product in-licensed
- Complex product expansion underway

**Cenexi Turnaround**
- Cenexi nearing breakeven
- New contract wins supportive
- Operational turnaround progressing

**Investment View**
- Key challenges largely behind
- Complex products offer growth
- CDMO expansion supports upside
- BUY stance strengthened

Good morning 
Nature does not hurry,
Yet everything is accomplished.

India Mobile continues to compound steadily

**Why read Six Faces of Globalization by Anthea Roberts & Nicolas Lamp?**

Globalization isn't just one story—it’s six competing narratives. This powerful book unpacks who wins, who loses, and why the debate matters more than ever.

**Key insights:**
 The Establishment View: Globalization drives prosperity through free markets.
🔹 The Left-Wing Critique: It widens inequality and fuels corporate power.
🔹 The Right-Wing Populist View: It undermines national identity and jobs.
🔹 The Green Perspective: Global growth endangers the planet.
🔹 Techno-Utopianism: Innovation and openness solve global problems.
🔹 Geoeconomic Realism: Nations use economics as a strategic weapon.

**Why read it?**
If you want a balanced view of globalization’s complexity, this book is your guide to understanding today’s global tug-of-war.

NUVAMA ON INDIAN IT SECTOR

STABLE Q1, GROWTH MOMENTUM EXPECTED TO IMPROVE

• Indian IT companies delivered largely stable Q1FY27 performance; most retained FY27 guidance

• Tier-2 IT companies continued to grow faster than larger peers; Infosys was a key exception to the broadly in-line trend

• Q2 growth expected to improve, supported by healthy deal wins, large-deal ramp-ups and demand for cloud, data & AI services

• Margins broadly met or beat expectations, helped by higher utilisation, operational efficiencies and productivity gains

• Discretionary spending remains cautious and client decision-making cycles continue to be elongated

• Nuvama says IT stocks are reacting more to global AI/Anti-AI trades than fundamentals; improving deal wins and relatively low valuations indicate stronger underlying fundamentals

• Generative AI could create new opportunities as enterprises seek secure application layers that can work across different LLMs and optimise token costs

• Verticals: BFSI & healthcare strongest; retail stable; manufacturing/auto soft; high-tech demand mixed

The Momentum Decoder: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (+60% in 1 month)

Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (NSE:KALYANKJIL) surged after posting a massive 46% jump in quarterly revenue, which triggered aggressive institutional buying despite some minor margin pressure. Smart money completely absorbed the initial post-earnings profit booking near ₹568, driving a sharp volume-backed recovery that pushed the stock to finish strong at ₹610.

Bottom Line: The structural growth is impressive, but chasing a vertical 60% rally leaves no margin of safety; wait for a healthy pullback toward ₹570 before considering new entries.

Yield Spike & Global Impact 🌍

The US 30Yr Treasury yield hit 5.28%, a high unseen since 2007. The US-Iran conflict pushed WTI Crude from $67 to $115/barrel before settling near $76.

Rising crude halted the inflation decline, sparking hawkish Federal Reserve shifts. The 10Yr Treasury yield has strong support at 4.5% and could hit 5%. The Dollar Index remains firm near 98.

Tactical Play: Elevated yields strengthen the USD but crush Gold and emerging equities. Gold ($4,341) faces downside risk to $3,800. The Nifty 50 and Indian Rupee will face bearish corrections.

🎯 Bottom Line: Oil-driven inflation fears have reignited US Treasury yields. Expect a strong US Dollar, capped upside for Gold, and delayed rallies in global equities until yields decisively fall.

NUVAMA ON TITAN

Rating: HOLD (Downgraded from BUY) , Target Price: ₹5,241 (Earlier ₹5,030)

• Q1 FY27 performance was strong with revenue up 36% YoY, EBITDA up 57% and net profit up 65%

• Jewellery revenue grew 43% to ₹15,900 Cr; domestic jewellery revenue rose 38%, with like-for-like growth of 33%

• Jewellery EBIT included an inventory gain of around ₹370 Cr; MTM inventory benefit was around 75–80 bps

• CaratLane revenue grew around 41%; EBIT margin improved sharply to 11.5% from 6.6%

• International jewellery revenue jumped 136%, but the segment reported an ₹8 Cr EBIT loss amid GCC geopolitical disruptions

• Watches and eyewear businesses both grew 22%

• Nuvama expects MTM benefits to moderate over the next 2–3 quarters, while customs-duty benefits could continue for another two quarters

• Despite strong fundamentals, the recent share-price rally has reduced upside potential, prompting the downgrade to HOLD.
